handoff.message: exact UTF-8 finalizer text, including final newline
handoff.destination: actual bound accepted document absolute path
handoff.output_sha256: SHA-256 of exact delivered document bytes
handoff.reviewer: exact standard kind/identity/model/method values from accepted receipt

verification_order: Check current policy and exact session scope
Require actual accepted review within this session
Run actual current finalizer and retain invocation outcome
Validate bounded typed finalizer fields against prepared packet, accepted review, actual local delivery receipt/state and owned destination
Compare exact delivered bytes and exact generated message bytes/digest without trimming or newline normalization
Run actual current verify-message on that exact generated message and require passed/hash equality
Recheck current package, scope-bound record and bytes before signed approval issuance/public return
approval_consumption: Verify current package/policy/scope/purpose plus sealed handoff receipt and unchanged delivered/message bytes before current approval use; never re-finalize to overwrite changed content.
negative_outcome: Typed approval_required/denied response; no approval issuance or task/provider/worker/notification acknowledgement effects. Actual failed invocation and existing delivery retained.
authority_limits: No Linear publication or status proof
No raw review record, review path or authority secret in response

cases.check: Actual current validator returns the unchanged additive handoff and existing approval fields; exact original receipt, document/message hashes, actual verify-message invocation; no task/provider/ack effects.

Installed aitm CLI from outside repository executes existing prepare/review/finalize with sealed scoped config; exact handoff bytes/metadata pass through. Synthetic semantic review provenance retained.
Installed actual MCP SDK stdio negotiation plus existing prepare/review/finalize returns identical structured/text JSON handoff; input schemas unchanged; no provider/model.
Individually omit or malform each required finalizer handoff field after an actual finalize; typed refusal and zero signed approval issuance. Retain original runtime receipt.
Alter message/content hash/objective/destination/reviewer/document status or substitute another session receipt; exact binding refusal before approval; no authority extrapolation.
Change, remove or symlink actual delivered/message files after actual finalize, including trailing newline-only message change; refuse exact-byte mismatch, preserving legitimate delivery evidence.
Actual verify-message refusal, missing/false pass or wrong returned message digest cannot become approval; retained invocation outcomes remain distinct.
Missing review, stale policy, changed draft and each foreign provider/workspace/principal/project/logical-session scope refuse before effect; retained historical receipts remain version-bound.
Current active signed legacy-style record missing handoff, unknown reference and changed signed record refuse rather than manufacture current approval.
Mutate delivered artifact/message/receipt after approval; actual task submission refuses with no core task/outbox/ack side effect, without re-finalizing to overwrite it.
Task/progress cross-purpose or cross-task approvals and using handoff text/ref as unrelated runtime/decision/task evidence remain rejected by existing authorities.
Exact public response whitelist, standard bounded reviewer metadata and existing CLI/MCP inputs remain unchanged; no raw review, private record or authority secret leaks.

execution_plan.initial: Focused new regression cases, existing tests/writing, relevant application intake/composition/protocol tests; Ruff on changed files; installed wheel entry points in a private env. No full suite.
execution_plan.retries: Up to three evidence-driven focused correction batches; preserve failing logs and same criteria, then report if unresolved. No paid/live calls.

evidence_classification: Actual local validator, product/CLI/MCP code and disposable databases; semantic positive/negative judgments are authored controls, not fresh AI, human acceptance, provider or host behavior.
